original_benchmark.notes: MotifBench (Critic's Eye, EMNLP 2026 Findings) Macbeth benchmark from Acture/MotifBench. After anti-leakage sanitization (removing 19 explicit Act/Scene/Line citation motifs, 40 passage-pointer motifs, and 60 local ±15-line verbatim 3-gram pairs), 218 clean candidate motifs and 270 query lines (449 pairs, 96.4% zero content-word overlap) are grouped into 12 contiguous Act-respecting scene-group tasks (13-36 queries/task; single-query 270-task mode also supported via --granularity query). Full play provided in both TXT and PDF formats under /app/.
